subject: BrightPath PoC runway: deployment mode recommendation & milestones
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara@brightpath.ai>, Mike Huang <mike.huang@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath PoC runway: deployment mode recommendation & milestones

Hi Sara / Mike —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Call highlights:
- BrightPath goal: integrate embeddings + chat assistant for clinical analytics UX, QPS ~120 peak, typical payloads ~600 tokens.
- Data sensitivity: a subset of data contains PHI; primary concern is data-in-flight and long-term retention.
- Decision timeline: looking to commit to a vendor for PoC by end of July, production by Q4.

High-level deployment guidance (based on what we heard):
- Hosted API: fastest path (1–2 days) to a functional PoC; best if PHI can be pre-filtered/removed or routed with tokenization.
- Dedicated capacity: recommended if you need predictable throughput (120 qps spikes) and near-zero throttling; keeps data logically isolated on reserved GPU pools.
- Private VPC / on-prem: advised if BrightPath must keep raw PHI behind customer-managed network / KMS. Longer lead time (infra & security approvals).

Proposed PoC runway (minimal friction / risk-aware):
1) Week 0 (this week): align success criteria & stakeholders.
2) Week 1: quick Hosted API pilot to validate model quality on scrubbed dataset (2–3 dev days).
3) Weeks 2–4: run a Dedicated capacity trial parallel to Hosted (if BrightPath agrees) to validate throughput and latency under realistic load.
4) Week 4: decision review — choose path to production (Hosted for MVP w/guardrails, Dedicated for throughput, Private for PHI-required).

Required inputs from BrightPath to finalize plan:
- Confirmation on data classification (what stays PHI?)
- Target SLA/latency (p95 target) and QPS profile (spikes/day)
- Stakeholder list for security & procurement approvals

Can we lock a kickoff on Monday 2027-06-28 for the Hosted pilot? If you prefer, we can delay kickoff a week to allow your security team to review the attached questionnaire.

Attachments: BrightPath_PoC_Security_Questions.pdf (your security team), PoC-Runway-Checklist.xlsx (owners/timeline).

Next steps (short):
- Sara: confirm kickoff preference + identify security contact for questionnaire (procurement@ or security@)
- Jonas / Vivek / Tessa: prepare lightweight Hosted pilot template + Dedicated trial cost snapshot

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sara Kline <sara@brightpath.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Huang <mike.huang@brightpath.ai>, procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: BrightPath PoC runway: deployment mode recommendation & milestones

Thanks Jonas — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) PHI scope: QA/clinical notes + certain identifiers (name, MRN) count as PHI. We can provide a scrubbed dataset for an initial quality check but the production flow will need to touch PHI.
2) Latency: we need p95 under 350ms for the assistant flows.
3) QPS profile: baseline ~30 qps, predictable spikes to ~140 qps during morning hours for batch analysis.
4) Decision: procurement wants to see cost delta Hosted vs Dedicated; security wants the questionnaire answered before any Dedicated or Private work.

We can aim for the Monday 6/28 kickoff for the Hosted pilot using scrubbed data. Security will review the attached PDF; I’ve looped procurement.

Couple asks: can you provide a short blurb on what metrics you’ll run during the Dedicated trial (latency, token cost, error rate)? Also, what is the expected timeline to stand up a Dedicated pool if we greenlight it?

Sara
Sara Kline
Head of Platform Engineering | BrightPath Analytics
sara@brightpath.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kline <sara@brightpath.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath PoC runway: deployment mode recommendation & milestones

Sara — thanks for the details, good constraints. Short technical response to your asks and a suggested mutual-action plan.

Dedicated trial metrics (what we’ll measure):
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for inference end-to-end (including any network hop); target p95 <= 350ms per your ask.
- Throughput: sustained qps and burst handling (we’ll measure token/sec and request/sec under replayed traffic).
- Cost: per-token cost and cost-per-session under typical batching; we’ll provide modeled estimates for Hosted vs Dedicated.
- Errors/failures: 5xx rates, tail retries, and cold-start incidence.
- Quality: sample-set response quality via your eval prompts (precision/recall style checks where applicable).

Timeline for Dedicated pool spin-up:
- If we provision from Redwood Dedicated (standard reserved pool): 7–10 business days for provisioning + basic verification.
- If you require private VPC with customer-managed KMS: estimate 3–5 weeks (security approvals + infra setup).

Suggested PoC owners and milestones (we can drop into the shared checklist):
- BrightPath: Sara (engineering lead), Mike (product), Procurement (procurement@brightpath.ai), Security reviewer TBD
- Redwood: Jonas (AE / program lead), Vivek (solutions & infra), Tessa (CS / success criteria & runbook)

Proposed 4-week PoC runbook (detailed):
Week 0: Kickoff & success criteria sign-off (hosted pilot dataset agreed)
Week 1: Hosted pilot - run 1k sample queries against scrubbed data; quick evaluation of quality + latency
Week 2: Stand up Dedicated trial (if approved) and begin synthetic load testing; start filling security evidence for Dedicated/Private path
Week 3: Parallel end-to-end testing with replayed traffic; collect metrics and cost model
Week 4: Review & recommendation meeting — produce go/no-go and production path recommendation + contract/commit outline

I’ll attach a PoC-Success-Criteria.docx and a populated PoC-Runway-Checklist.xlsx to this thread for your review.

If we lock kickoff 2027-06-28, Redwood will:
- Prepare Hosted pilot environment and example prompts by 6/27 EOD
- Share Dedicated trial cost snapshot by 6/30

Happy to jump on a 30-min technical sync before kickoff; suggest Thu 6/24 10:00am PT if that works for your engineers.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

We agree to kickoff hosted pilot 6/28 with scrubbed dataset. Security will return the questionnaire by EOD Mon 6/28.
